description.text: Featured advantages 1. Partner universities It cooperates with Durham University (Fortune 100 in the world), Lancaster University, Coventry University and other international famous universities. 2. Cultivation mode Sino-foreign joint training, directly promoted to international famous universities master's degree. 3. Years of cultivation In China, complete the general undergraduate 4-year course in 3 years, saving students' time and capital costs for studying abroad. Cultivation goals This major is organized by our school in cooperation with international famous universities, aiming to cultivate high-end talents with international vision, advanced theories and service skills in international economics and trade, familiar with international business and trade rules, proficient in English communication skills, and competent in the global trade industry. Core courses International famous master's degree pathway course, international IELTS English course, international master's thesis guidance course, classroom group cooperation display course (Presentation), personal study abroad planning course international trade, international trade practice, international business English, cross-border e-commerce theory and practice, cross-border e-commerce project planning, international finance, international commercial law, international settlement, international business management, customs declaration and inspection practice, foreign trade documentary practice, POCIB international trade comprehensive training, etc.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Wuchang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Colored scanned copy of passport which is valid for at least one year 2. White background colored bareheaded digital photo in Passport size(The head takes up 2/3 of the size of the photo; the photo pixel is no less than 320*240, the aspect ratio is 4:3, the size is 100-500kb, JPG format) 3. The colored scanned copy of the original diploma of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.) 4. The colored scanned copy of the original transcript of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.) 5. Educational background and working experience detailed from primary school to the date of application 6. Transfer letter with attendance record for applicants with studying experience in China 7. Fixed deposit certificate with minimum US $3000 8. Medical report 9. None criminal record

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy. Non-Chinese citizens of secondary high school graduates, holding valid foreign passports in good health and with good character.
